review_candidates.description: Executive Assistant Job Title: Executive Assistant Work Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week) Schedule/Timezone: Monday to Friday, U.S. Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours Location: 100% Remote (Latin America Candidates Only) Overview Are you a sharp, proactive operational partner who thrives on bringing structure, clarity, and discipline to a high-energy founder? This role supports the founder and executive leader of a premier field-services and commercial plumbing business alongside a secondary, lower-touch venture. Rather than traditional administrative schedule-management, this position acts as the primary filter, operational force-multiplier, and communication anchor for a high-performing leader who excels in high-pressure deal-making and problem-solving. We are looking for an assertive, highly discerning assistant who can take complete ownership of daily communication, protect executive focus, and turn operational noise into organized, actionable insight. Key Responsibilities Own Inbox Operations End-to-End: Triage incoming correspondence, filter noise, and learn to draft and send routine emails directly in the executive’s voice within six months. Execute Context-First Triage: Apply an "ask the next question" standard to gather critical context (property history, addresses, key decision-makers, opportunity scale) before bringing items to the executive. Identify High-Value Opportunities: Distinguish critical business requests and high-scale opportunities (property management, new territories, service escalations) from generic cold outreach or low-priority tasks. Protect Executive Time & Rhythm: Strictly enforce an established weekly schedule, including protected focus days, field-work mornings, and office blocks, permitting deviations only with explicit sign-off. Maintain Communication Integrity: Draft, proofread, and tone-check outgoing written communications to ensure accuracy, professionalism, and appropriate nuance. Monitor Accountability & Delegation: Calmly and factually track delegated tasks, documenting non-compliance early so issues can be handled strategically rather than reactively. Manage Travel & Expenses: Coordinate end-to-end travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense tracking platforms (Concur, Ramp). Cross-Business Coordination: Maintain full ownership of the primary business inbox while remaining fluent across both related ventures to navigate overlapping discussions seamlessly. Strategic Escalation: Serve as a strict gatekeeper, escalating only high-priority issues, specifically anything involving financial commitments, contracts, off-hours scheduling, personal contact details, or personnel matters. Must-Have Requirements Executive Support Experience: Proven track record directly supporting a founder or senior executive, preferably in fast-paced, hands-on industries (trades, field services, or operational businesses) over rigid corporate environments. Assertive & Direct Communication: Willingness to push back constructively, ask blunt clarifying questions, and offer honest feedback without default deference. Resilience Under Pressure: Even-keeled demeanor capable of handling fast-paced, demanding, or terse moments calmly and professionally. Exceptional Written English: Flawless spelling, grammar, and a keen ear for tone control and message refinement. High-Level Triage & Discretion: Independent judgment to differentiate between genuine opportunity, routine operational needs, and cold sales pitch noise, while maintaining absolute confidentiality. Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Google Workspace, MS Office, modern calendar scheduling tools, and expense platforms (Concur, Ramp). Availability: Ability to work full-time hours aligned with U.S. Pacific Standard Time (PST), Monday through Friday. Nice-to-Have Requirements Prior experience supporting a multi-company founder or serial entrepreneur. Familiarity with the trades, plumbing, or field-service industries. Experience working alongside executives who utilize hands-off, SOP-driven management frameworks. Why Join Us This is not a standard, passive administrative role. It is a strategic partnership where your gatekeeping and operational discipline directly drive business growth. You will enjoy the stability of a reliable Monday-through-Friday schedule with fully protected weekends, a competitive USD hourly rate, and the dynamic environment of working directly with an accomplished entrepreneur. If you take pride in bringing calm organization to fast-moving operations and being the indispensable right hand to a founder, this is the perfect place to make your mark.

Create high-quality Jira tickets that provide engineers with the information they need to resolve issues quickly. Resolve customer issues directly whenever a technical fix, configuration change, or workaround can be applied without development work. Prioritise and manage support work across customer impact, business priorities, and operational risk. Become a recognised product expert, supporting customers and colleagues with deep product and technical knowledge. Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders through regular meetings and ongoing collaboration. Sort major customer milestones, including go-lives, white glove activities, and occasional on-site visits. Manage customer software releases and help ensure deployments are delivered smoothly and successfully. Use trends from customer issues and bug reports to help improve product quality, testing, and operational processes. Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, ensuring customer feedback helps shape future improvements. Create and maintain knowledge articles, guides, videos, and other self-service content that enables customers to succeed. Continuously identify opportunities to improve how we work through automation, AI, and process improvements. You've worked in an enterprise software environment and understand the importance of building long-term customer relationships. You enjoy taking ownership and seeing problems through to completion rather than simply passing them on. You're a self-starter who thrives when trusted to work independently and make decisions. You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding how systems work beneath the surface. You have strong problem-solving skills and can take a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting. You communicate effectively with everyone from end users to software engineers and senior stakeholders. You're comfortable challenging assumptions, raising risks, and escalating concerns when necessary. You have practical SQL experience and are comfortable writing and running queries. You have experience with scripting or programming concepts, including JavaScript. You have an interest in AI and emerging technologies and how they can improve customer outcomes, team efficiency, and product experiences. Experience with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform is advantageous. Bonus points if you have Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise business applications (such as WorkDay, Star, SAP etc.). Experience working with APIs, integrations, or data pipelines. Familiarity with technologies such as .NET, JSON, JavaScript, or Vue. Experience working with Azure Data Factory or similar integration technologies. An understanding of how large professional services organisations operate. Experience managing customer-facing software releases or deployment activities. Experience working within a geographically distributed team across multiple time zones. Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, troubleshooting, knowledge management, or customer support processes. What You'll Get 31 days' vacation per year, including public holidays, and increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 38 days. Paid four-week sabbatical in your fifth anniversary year on top of your holiday entitlement. Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits Disability and life insurance 401k with employer matching At least $1,400 per year to spend on professional and personal development. Regular All Hands meeting for inspiration and over-communication Monthly team events (sometimes in-person, sometimes virtual). Volunteering time - up to 20 hours a year to participate in volunteer work. Genuinely nice, smart people to work with, who are excited about growing our company Working Details This is a full-time role (37.5 hours per week), working 09AM - 5.30PM (CT) from Monday to Friday. We are looking for someone to join the team remotely in/around Austin or San Antonio, Texas, in order to support customers across the United States, and to facilitate occasional in-person collaboration with others within the US team. Join the team! Equality of opportunity is more than just a responsibility: we believe it's a huge advantage to welcome a variety of experiences and perspectives into the team. Diversity is a great asset and, as such, we strongly encourage applications from any background. This is your opportunity to really influence how we get things done, and how our product helps our customers improve their working lives. We're doing well, but there's lots more to do in order to maintain the high bar and pace that we've set. Everyone here is growing personally as the company grows, so if that sounds like something you'd like to be part of, we'd love to see your application. The deadline for applications is 5PM CT, Friday 18 September. Please note the successful candidate for this role will be subject to background checks and will have an opportunity to declare anything to us beforehand*
